criteria.notes: The kiosk preserves the accepted destination search, map selection, route, off-map, reset, and editable detail workflow.
The supplied illustrated Veszprem map remains dominant, sharp, and uncropped at both declared surfaces.
The bilingual visitor-centre shell and map-first interaction remain specific to wayfinding rather than a generic dashboard.
Primary destinations, route metrics, controls, and details remain readable at Full HD and compact kiosk size.
Light, dark, and custom shell palettes preserve readable contrast around the fixed map artwork.
Long titles and destination copy wrap or fit without clipped glyphs, collision, or unreadable reduction.
All 14 screenshots keep the map/list balance stable; the selected detail rail remains bounded with intentional scrolling as fallback.
Packaged SVG detail, semantic shell colors, location highlights, and route overlays remain visually aligned.
This map-led touchscreen composition teaches wayfinding mechanics without imposing dashboard styling on generated apps.
